artifacts.minimum_depth: Every material official, filing, broker, market, and failed-probe source is registered.
artifacts.blocking_conditions: A high-impact claim lacks a registered source or weak evidence is upgraded to primary evidence.
artifacts.verifier_check: source registry and JSON twin present

artifacts.minimum_depth: All named-customer, order, certification, capacity, ASP, utilization, margin, and platform claims are audited.
artifacts.blocking_conditions: An unaudited high-impact claim supports core status, EPS, or valuation.
artifacts.verifier_check: claim audit and JSON twin present

artifacts.minimum_depth: All eight AIDC blocks include listed, overseas/private, demand-anchor, low-purity, and unavailable nodes where relevant.
artifacts.blocking_conditions: A mandatory block is missing or the universe is only a listed-stock table.

artifacts.minimum_depth: Every covered ticker has at least one traceable relationship row and a valuation consequence.
artifacts.blocking_conditions: A core ticker lacks company-level product/customer economics or relies on demand-anchor inference.

artifacts.minimum_depth: Block-level economics plus ticker-level revenue, margin, EPS, and validation bridges for every core candidate.
artifacts.blocking_conditions: Generic demand or capacity supports EPS/valuation without conversion evidence.

artifacts.minimum_depth: Every AI/order/ASP-dependent core candidate receives a driver bridge or an explicit watchlist downgrade.
artifacts.blocking_conditions: High-growth valuation credit lacks unit/order/ASP-proxy-to-EPS math.
artifacts.verifier_check: growth artifacts and driver JSON present

artifacts.minimum_depth: Each investable ticker has business-model-matched primary and secondary methods, market/Street reconciliation, and disclosed scenario math.
artifacts.blocking_conditions: Missing current-price target/range, method mismatch, unreconciled arithmetic, or missing Model Reproducibility: PASS.
artifacts.verifier_check: valuation artifacts, structured JSON, and reproducibility PASS

artifacts.minimum_depth: Chinese prose-led chapters, decision-ready first chapter, readable sourced exhibits, and a complete compiled PDF.
artifacts.blocking_conditions: Table-only core chapters, untranslated recommendation logic, missing valuation summary, or render defects.
artifacts.verifier_check: XeLaTeX build, extracted-text review, and rendered-page inspection

artifacts.minimum_depth: Maker-checker review at every gate with fixed/verified/closed lifecycle and final IC consistency check.
artifacts.blocking_conditions: Open S, open unwaived A, score below 90, failed verifier, material residual-risk conflict, or missing final sign-off.
